svg.aria-label: A customer files a request. It does not say which charge it is about. The agent read the billing records, found no $20 charge, and asked instead of guessing. The customer answers in the same conversation. The refund is allowed, and paid once. At a second company, $980 is above the limit. Nothing is paid until a person approves. The staff console shows the refund, its amount, and why it needs approval. Approved, then paid exactly once. The ticket's workflow waited for the decision. An operator's kill switch stops the agent at its next step. Only a person can resume it.

g.text: A customer files a request. It does not say which charge it is about.
The agent read the billing records, found no $20 charge, and asked instead of guessing.
The customer answers in the same conversation. The refund is allowed, and paid once.
At a second company, $980 is above the limit. Nothing is paid until a person approves.
The staff console shows the refund, its amount, and why it needs approval.
Approved, then paid exactly once. The ticket's workflow waited for the decision.
An operator's kill switch stops the agent at its next step. Only a person can resume it.
